status: Ready for live testing; QuickCSS dependency blocker resolved; real Discord/account acceptance pending

security.scope: Read-only independent advisory/version review for full Vencord QuickCSS. Parent owns actual package/code reachability investigation and build.

verdict.recommendation: Build pinned ESM Monaco 0.57.0 with resolved DOMPurify 3.4.17 and verify the actual executable output.
verdict.dompurify_3_4_15: Not an all-known-advisories-fixed baseline: within five published vendor advisory ranges. Earlier reported severe advisories are outside its affected ranges.
verdict.dompurify_3_4_17: Latest npm and upstream release at review time. Outside all published affected ranges in the 36 distinct advisories examined; this is not a guarantee against undisclosed vulnerabilities or unsafe integration.
verdict.exploitability: Not established for QuickCSS. Package/version inclusion and matching an affected version range do not demonstrate the required input/configuration/reparse path.
verdict.conditional_exception: 3.4.15 could only be classified not affected for specific advisories after proving their preconditions absent in every reachable sanitizer path. Do not describe such a reachability assessment as patched or use it to claim all five bugs fixed.

monaco.evidence_type: Official pinned release changelog plus npm metadata; this side review did not inspect the actual served binary.

advisories_affecting_3_4_15.title: SMIL attributeName=href guard is skipped when PARSER_MEDIA_TYPE is application/xhtml+xml
advisories_affecting_3_4_15.exploit_preconditions: PARSER_MEDIA_TYPE=application/xhtml+xml plus allowing SVG animate/set and attributeName; crafted SMIL changes a link target and execution requires a click. Default text/html configuration is not affected by this issue.
advisories_affecting_3_4_15.quickcss_reachability: Not assessed by this side review; parent must verify configuration and data flow.

advisories_affecting_3_4_15.title: IN_PLACE: hook that removes a parent or sibling leaves the detached subtree's event handlers armed (incomplete fix for GHSA-p98j-92pf-mc4p)
advisories_affecting_3_4_15.exploit_preconditions: Attacker-influenced DOM input, IN_PLACE=true, and an application hook removing an ancestor or unvisited sibling; detached event handlers remain live. This is an incomplete-fix follow-up to GHSA-p98j-92pf-mc4p.
advisories_affecting_3_4_15.quickcss_reachability: Not assessed by this side review; parent must verify configuration and data flow.

advisories_affecting_3_4_15.title: SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES bypass: split template expressions survive in attached shadow root content on DOM output modes
advisories_affecting_3_4_15.exploit_preconditions: SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES=true plus a DOM-returning mode, DOM input with an attached shadow root, and subsequent evaluation by a template engine. Merely returning a DOM node is insufficient.
advisories_affecting_3_4_15.quickcss_reachability: Not assessed by this side review; parent must verify configuration and data flow.

advisories_affecting_3_4_15.title: IN_PLACE: node-removing afterSanitize hook leaves detached subtree event handlers armed, causing DOM XSS
advisories_affecting_3_4_15.exploit_preconditions: Attacker-influenced live DOM input, IN_PLACE=true, and a node-removing afterSanitizeElements/afterSanitizeAttributes hook; handlers survive on a detached subtree.
advisories_affecting_3_4_15.quickcss_reachability: Not assessed by this side review; parent must verify configuration and data flow.

advisories_affecting_3_4_15.title: DOMPurify 3.4.x: IN_PLACE returns a force-removed rawtext root whose text carries attacker markup — pure HTML reparse executes
advisories_affecting_3_4_15.exploit_preconditions: Node input with IN_PLACE=true returns a force-removed rawtext root, followed by serialization and HTML reparsing. appendChild alone does not trigger the described payload.
advisories_affecting_3_4_15.quickcss_reachability: Not assessed by this side review; parent must verify configuration and data flow.

coverage.discrepancy: The global database version query returns two matches for 3.4.15; the vendor has three additional published advisories fixed in 3.4.17. A scan relying only on indexed advisories can miss those three.
coverage.interpretation: Use vendor patched-version metadata together with release notes. Some advisory report bodies retain pre-fix wording or reporter-proposed severity; published metadata rates all five low and identifies fixes.

implementationReview.verdict: No unresolved blocking issue found in the current split source and supplied HTML/JS pair. The original URL-size and clipped-error findings are resolved for this pair. Final native Electron acceptance remains with the assigned QA agent.
implementationReview.scope: Read-only review plus lightweight in-memory assertions and JavaScript syntax parsing. No product edits, application installations, rebuilds, browser tests or live Electron execution by this reviewer.

resolved_findings.title: Oversized data URL
resolved_findings.previous_evidence: Historical inline artifact produced a 7,771,354-byte data URL; a historical packaged/minified integration probe still produced 7,758,862 characters.
resolved_findings.resolution: Only HTML/CSS travel through loadURL(data:). The 5,448,352-byte trusted JS bundle is separately embedded at build time and executed after navigation through webContents.executeJavaScript. The current data URL is 507,102 bytes. The security guard rejects oversized URLs.
resolved_findings.validation: Measured current pair and exercised the URL-size guard; reviewed exact main-process transformation. No native execution performed.

resolved_findings.title: Clipped startup error
resolved_findings.resolution: #status now uses position:absolute; inset:0; box-sizing:border-box, with its own foreground/background. It no longer sits below the full-height editor container.
resolved_findings.validation: Inspected source and asserted overlay rule in emitted HTML. Actual failure rendering remains a native QA acceptance case.

patch_follow_up.evidence: All monaco-editor subpath imports now resolve with createRequire rooted in the dedicated dependency directory. Bare monaco-editor explicitly targets the pinned ESM entry, whose existence was checked. record() rejects node_modules inputs outside the dependency directory.
patch_follow_up.validation: Current split metadata has no ancestor node_modules inputs; all 1,114 input hashes match. Earlier integration success evidence predates the new input-root rejection guard, so it was not treated as a test of that rejection branch.

patch_follow_up.evidence: DOMPurify 3.4.17 override is in pnpm-workspace.yaml; package.json retains exact direct dependencies. The builder verifies package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml and pnpm-lock.yaml against the frozen dependency directory.
patch_follow_up.validation: All three files matched the prepared frozen directory. Lock integrity matches the official registry value recorded in security-review.json.

patch_follow_up.evidence: worker.terminate is wrapped with its original method bound to the worker; the wrapper deletes that worker from the tracking Set. pagehide terminates remaining workers and revokes the two cached worker source URLs. disposed blocks later worker creation.
patch_follow_up.validation: Source review; compiled editor input hash ed0fe49440c8ba5d37cde37d07408224e9aa0941c1261ae9737d634fc3c6e885 matches the supplied split bundle metadata.

flow: Build produces separate monacoWin.html and monacoWin.js.
The pinned main-process source import is replaced with file://monacoWin.html?base64 and file://monacoWin.js?base64.
Existing file-URI loader reads these build assets as base64 strings; neither resource is fetched over the network.
The existing await win.loadURL(data:text/html;base64,...) completes before decoding and passing monacoScript to await win.webContents.executeJavaScript.
User CSS is subsequently obtained by getCurrentCss and passed to monaco.editor.createModel; it is not interpolated into executed source.
security_meaning: executeJavaScript is a privileged host-driven execution path that can run the trusted bundle despite document script-src none. The CSP must not be described as preventing this host operation.
The code executes in the page world, with contextIsolation=true and nodeIntegration=false preserved. It does not expose Node APIs to the page merely by using executeJavaScript.
No generic renderer-controlled eval IPC, remote code URL, or user-CSS-to-executed-source concatenation was introduced by the inspected transformation.
The trust boundary is the packaged script and main-process call site. Keep that source fixed to the verified build asset; the existing native bridge remains a capability available to page code.

The HTML CSP denies page script tags and renderer network connections while allowing the intentional blob-worker path and inline styles/data fonts. This is defense in depth, not proof that all native bridge effects are blocked.
trusted_script_loading.preload_routing: The data: document and upstream choice between preload.js/vencordDesktopPreload.js are retained. The preload still takes its existing QuickCSS branch.
trusted_script_loading.startup_completion_limit: Awaiting executeJavaScript does not by itself prove editor readiness: the bundled outer IIFE launches an inner async initialization without returning that promise. Native QA should wait for editor/worker behavior and save/reopen results, not only the executeJavaScript promise.

feature_comparison.assessment: getCurrentCss -> createModel(css,'css') preserved. A bridge rejection or non-string response goes to the error overlay. Native readCss's existing error-to-empty-string behavior was not changed by this work.
onDidChangeModelContent -> setCss preserved, including existing preload debounce.
Dark/default-light selection and editor.layout on resize preserved.
Editor features, CSS definitions and CSS language services registered; installed Monaco sources prefer MonacoEnvironment.getWorker for both worker paths.
Existing makeLinksOpenExternally retained; connect-src none does not prohibit native external-browser opens.
Inspected standalone storage is in-memory. Clipboard has fallback paths, but actual keyboard/context-menu behavior requires native QA.
